newsitem.title: HONDURAS: North and Central America port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: North and Central America port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

HONDURAS, July 7 - Puerto Cortes - Six vessels berthed of which 4 discharging/loading containers, 1 discharging fertiliser, 1 discharging bananas on pallets. 2 Vessels awaiting berths to load/discharge containers. 18 Vessels due of which 5 to discharge bananas, 10 to load/discharge containers, 1 passenger/vehicles, 2 to discharge fertiliser. Puerto Cortes - July 8 - Four vessels berthed of which 2 discharging/loading containers, 1 discharging/loading containers/bananas, 1 discharging corn. 20 Vessels due of which 11 to discharge/load containers/general cargo, 5 to discharge/load containers/bananas, 2 to discharge/load general cargo, 1 to discharge liquid chemicals, 1 passenger vessel.

MEXICO, July 8 - All ports working normally. Tampico - 13 Vessels in port of which 2 containers, 2 general cargo, 1 pipes, 2 steel coils, 1 pvc, 1 clinker, 1 cement, 2 corn, 1 gasoline. Altamira - Two vessels in port of which 1 containers, 1 chemicals. Veracruz - 10 Vessels in port of which 1 steel coils, 1 scrap, 1 pipes, 3 sugar, 3 grain, 1 under repair. Manzanillo - Nine vessels in port of which 1 cement, 2 containers, 2 steel coils, 4 fish meal. Coatzacoalcos - 16 Vessels in port of which 7 chemicals, 9 oil tankers.

PANAMA, July 7 - Cristobal, Balboa - Working normally. Panama Canal - The waterway is operating at reduced capacity from 7/7 and for a period of 13 days, due to lock lane outages at Miraflores and Gatun for major maintenance and improvement. 31 Vessels due, 16 in queue, 14 booked, 32 scheduled. Situation 6/7, actual arrivals 32, transits 31. Average of booked and non-booked canal waters time 14.5 hours.

UNITED STATES, July 7 - Honolulu, HI - Honolulu harbour - 1 Container vessel, 4 tugs and barges berthed. Honolulu anchorage - 1 Tanker. Barbers Point harbour - 2 Barges berthed. Off point mooring - 1 Tanker.
